title: Montreal Private City Tour by Luxury SUV
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Here's a brief overview of what to expect from a city tour in Montréal with a private chauffeur/guide - great if you want comfort, local insights and flexibility.

Here's what the tour includes:

-Private vehicle with chauffeur: Travel comfortably in a LUXURY SEDAN with pickup and drop-off at your hotel or CHOSEN LOCATION.

-Chauffeur/Guide: A knowledgeable local guide (often bilingual English/French, other languages possible on request).

-Flexible itinerary: Tour routes are usually adjustable based on your interests - history, architecture, culture, food stops, neighbourhood highlights, etc.

-Popular highlights: Common stops include Vieux-Montréal (Old Montreal), Mount Royal lookout, Notre-Dame Basilica, Saint-Joseph Oratory, Olympic stadium, Westmount and scenic viewpoints - all while your guide shares stories and local context.

Typical tour format:
4 hours tour, more in-depth experience with longer stops and storytelling by your guide.
